description_sq:
Shitet apartament 3+1+2 i konvertuar ne 2+1+2
Nbodhet ne katin e 12 dhe te fundit te nje pallati shume cilesor dhe te mire administruar.
Apartamenti eshte i organizuar ne nje sallon te madh i cili eshte i ndare ne 2 ambiente ndenjieje
te cilet jane te ndare ne mes me nje oxhak.
Ambienti i gatimit eshte i vecuar.
Dhomat e gjumit jane ne vete dhe aksesohet me ane te nje koridori.
Apartamenti ka nje verande e cila aksesohet nga te gjithe ambientet e apartamentit.
Per me shume informacion na kontaktoni!
description_en: 3+1+2 apartment for sale, converted to 2+1+2. It is located on the 12th and last floor of a very high-quality and well-managed building. The apartment is organized in a large living room which is divided into 2 living rooms which are divided in the middle by a fireplace. The cooking environment is separate. The bedrooms are separate and accessed through a corridor. The apartment has a veranda which is accessible from all the premises of the apartment. For more information contact us!
